newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Malaysia says not ready to open financial market.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia says not ready to open financial market.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Tuesday ruled out an early opening of his country's financial market to foreign banks.

"The need for Malaysia is to go slow on that because we fear that some of the big banks in Japan, Europe and America might just come in and swallow up our banks," he told a news conference in Bahrain, where he is attending an economic forum.
"At the moment we are in the process of consultation. We are urging Malaysian banks to merge so they can become big enough to compete with the big banks which are coming in," Mahathir said.
He said Malaysia was under pressure "to open up the financial market but we are not ready yet."
